reason: A offers a more physically grounded and testable intervention: trace boron can plausibly improve grain-boundary cohesion in BCC refractory alloys, with boride formation and mechanical/irradiation responses directly measurable against NbMoTaW. Its irradiation-sink benefit remains speculative and borides technically preclude a wholly single-phase alloy, but B is weaker because 10 at.% V is not a minor addition, its BCC “stacking-fault-energy” rationale is questionable, and substitutional V does not inherently create additional defect sinks.
